scope: Component-aware collision measurement for batched Q01 geometry. Scripted input on the shared engine with hardware WebGL; the deliberate-overlap controls run inside the live scene. Not a human playtest, not an FPS or duration measure, not an art or story acceptance.

change.producer: witness-q01.js: WitnessQ01.batch keeps every merged mesh own box in userData.batchParts (group-local); batching, draw calls and rendered geometry are unchanged.
change.measurement: test/q01-geometry-guard.cjs holds the shared measurement; test/architecture-browser.mjs measures the per-mesh boxes with the unchanged thresholds (body 0.28 m, body band 0.23-1.65 m, camera 0.16 m).
change.controls: test/q01-geometry.cjs proves the merged envelope is the false positive and that a body inside a part is still reported; every recorded walk also checks one deliberate body overlap, one deliberate camera overlap and one overlap six metres away.

unit.note: Each file of the npm test script run in order; npm test itself stalls on this host (finding F04).

environment.gpu: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) Arc(TM) Graphics (0x00007D55) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

findings.title: test:architecture-browser failed on the batching commit
findings.detail: The static batching merged every mesh that shares a material, and the rendered-geometry guard measured one merged envelope, so it reported body collisions against q01-batched-q01-b-rubble and q01-batched-q01-b-stone on the Q01 roof. The producer now keeps each merged mesh own box and the gate measures those boxes; the same gate that failed on 764dc8a passes here with 0 body, camera and geometry errors, while every deliberate overlap is still detected.

findings.title: A fresh checkout cannot pass the build GI hash guard on Windows
findings.detail: core.autocrlf=true and there is no .gitattributes, so vendor/witness-q01-gi-data.js is checked out with CRLF endings and its recorded LF hash no longer matches. The engine build pin has the same problem: tools/environment-kit/build-engine.cjs refuses to run against the committed copy of vendor/adventure-3d.js. Both are scheduled for PR-04.1B.

findings.title: Committed dist/ is not byte-reproducible from the sources
findings.detail: The build reports the same content but rewrites the tracked copies with different line endings; git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol reports no content difference. PR-04.1B owns the normalisation.

findings.title: npm script chains stall on this host
findings.detail: npm test starts the pretest hook and then the spawned cmd.exe keeps no child process and never exits. The same script files pass when run one by one. PR-04.1C owns the runner and the CI workflow.

limits: Scripted input on the shared engine; no human playtest, no FPS or playtime measurement.
The fix changes measurement only: rendered geometry, batching, draw calls, collision, save and contract are untouched.
No art approval, no G3/G4 closure, no story acceptance, no deployment evidence.
Heavy artefacts (images, traces, logs) stay in outputs/agent-work/pr04-1a and are not committed.
